test_client_interceptor_chain: test the gRPC client interceptor chain by logging unary unary and stream stream calls
test_server_interceptor_chain: test the gRPC server interceptor chain with conditional interceptors based on metadata headers
test_defective_client_interceptor: test a defective gRPC client interceptor that raises an exception and returns INTERNAL status code
test_request_iterator_wrapping: test wrapping a request iterator with a stream interceptor that triples each request message
test_header_manipulation_interceptor: test appending custom metadata headers via a client interceptor and verifying on the server side
